text:
Priya: quick triage thread for the midnight routing wobble that caused a DNS failover + loadbalancer retry burst. need owners and short timelines.

Tom: quick summary: an automated zone-rebalance job changed route preference for a subset of prefixes; some edge nodes then sent traffic to a pool with stale certs -> TLS resets -> LB retries and client 5xx spikes.

Jorge: evidence snippet from edge logs: ```
[edge-node-3] 2026-07-15T00:23:12Z TLS alert: unexpected_message; peer reset after ClientHello
[lb-proxy] 2026-07-15T00:23:13Z upstream failure, retrying (attempt=1)
```

Priya: Action A (owner: Jorge) - rotate stale certs on the affected pool and verify cert chains. ETA 2026-07-16 12:00 UTC. Please attach cert fingerprint to INC-5180.

Jorge: On it. Also Action B (owner: Tom) - add a pre-change validation step to zone-rebalance job to check active cert expiry and SNI mapping. ETA 2026-07-20. I'll add unit tests.

Elise: Action C (owner: Elise) - create a short-term alert: net.lb.retry_spike -> page if retries/sec > 50 for 5m AND tls_reset_rate > 0.2% for 10m. ETA 2026-07-16. This avoids noisy alerts but catches triage-worthy events.

ops-bot: Ticket INC-5180 created: dns-lb-cert-retry-burst. Link: https://tickets.redwood/INC-5180

Tom: Action D (owner: Priya) - disable aggressive client retries at LB for 30m window post zone-rebalance. Implement as a flag in lb-config + rollout doc. ETA 2026-07-16. This mitigates retry storms while we confirm route health.

Priya: I'll coordinate with oncall. Also Action E (owner: Tom) - add a canary step to the zone-rebalance that shifts 2% traffic first and validates TLS across regions for 10 minutes before full commit. ETA 2026-07-18.

Elise: recurring pattern note: similar to incidents in April and May when config-driven prefix shifts happened without certificate/ingress compatibility checks. Proposal: add a "config compatibility" gate in the change template that exercises real TLS handshakes against target pools before route moves.

Jorge: Agreed. I'll add the gate to network change template and document the test harness. ETA 2026-07-22.

Priya: small mitigation runbook snippet for oncall to use during future events:
1) run: `curl -v --resolve api.redwood:443:1.2.3.4 https://api.redwood/health` to validate SNI/cert chain.
2) if TLS reset observed, run `lbctl set-retry-policy --window 30s --backoff 200ms` to damp retries.
3) if cert mismatch, run `cert-rotate --pool affected-pool` and post status to INC ticket.

Tom: Note about risks: disabling retries increases error rate for legitimate transient failures. Keep the disable window short and monitor latency.

Elise: Monitoring items tracked:
- create dashboard panel: lb.retry_vs_tls_resets (owner Elise) ETA 7/16
- add synthetic DNS+TLS probe from eu/east/us regions (owner Priya) ETA 7/17

Jorge: CI/QA changes: add an integration test that simulates route shift + SNI mismatch and fails the zone-rebalance job if mismatches appear. (owner Jorge) ETA 7/22

Priya: final checklist from this thread:
- [ ] INC-5180 created and linked (ops-bot)
- [ ] rotate certs on affected pool (Jorge) - ETA 7/16
- [ ] pre-change cert check in zone-rebalance job (Tom) - ETA 7/20
- [ ] short-term alert and dashboard (Elise) - ETA 7/16
- [ ] LB retry short-window flag + runbook update (Priya) - ETA 7/16
- [ ] canary traffic step for rebalance (Tom) - ETA 7/18
- [ ] add config compatibility gate to change template (Jorge) - ETA 7/22
- [ ] synthetic DNS+TLS probes (Priya) - ETA 7/17

Priya: please update INC-5180 as you make progress. We'll reconvene on the follow-up sync Friday 2026-07-17 16:00 UTC. Thanks :+1:

Elise: pinged dashboard team to request new panels.

Tom: prepping PR for pre-change validation tests.

Jorge: rotating certs now, will post fingerprint and CAPTUREs to the ticket when done.
